articles.text: 学生: もしもし、(友達の名字)さんのお宅ですか。 (Gakusei: Moshi moshi, (friend's family name)-san no otaku desu ka?)
STUDENT: Hello. Is this the (friend's family name) residence?
友達: はい、そうです。 (Tomodachi: Hai, soo desu.)
学生: (友達の名前)さんいらっしゃいますか。 (Gakusei: (friend's first name)-san irasshaimasu ka?)
友達: 私ですが… (Tomodachi: Watakushi desu ga...)
FRIEND: Speaking. (Then the student and friend reverse their roles and practice again.)
